name: github
description: Manage repos, issues, pull requests, and Actions.

GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: GitHub personal access token
GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained or classic PAT from https://github.com/settings/tokens with the repo scopes you want the agent to use.

GITHUB_MCP_FEATURES.title: GitHub MCP feature flags (optional)
GITHUB_MCP_FEATURES.description: Comma-separated feature flags sent in the X-MCP-Features header. Set mcp_apps_disable_form_deferral so issue_write, create_pull_request and update_pull_request run directly instead of waiting on an interactive form, which automations and background agents cannot submit. Leave empty to keep GitHub's defaults.
